name: Sheba
overview: Sheba is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Raamah. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide further details about his tribe or additional notes. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical.
namesAndTitles: The name Sheba is a proper name meaning "oath" or "seven," as given in Genesis 10:7. This meaning reflects the Hebrew origins of the name but was not explicitly given by God.
familyAndRelationships: Sheba is recorded as the son of Raamah according to Genesis 10:7. Scripture does not provide further family relationships or tribal affiliations for Sheba beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Sheba's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his place within the genealogies of Genesis, marking him as a descendant of Noah's lineage through Raamah. This genealogical record contributes to understanding the spread of nations and peoples after the flood, emphasizing God's providential ordering of human history.
